meta.name: spec-driven
meta.description: Guide spec-driven development workflow (Requirements → Design → Tasks → Implementation) with approval gates between phases. Use when user wants structured feature planning or says "use spec-driven" or "follow the spec process".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按规格驱动开发流程，自动推进各阶段审批
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从需求到实现都遵循结构化的规格驱动流程
copy.tagline_en: Guide spec-driven development workflow with phase approvals
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want structured feature planning from requirements to implementation with approval gates

howto.what: Claude 变成项目编排者，不会自己写文档或代码。它会依次启动需求、设计、任务等子代理，并在每个阶段后要求你审批通过，再进入下一步。
howto.when: 当你提到“use spec-driven”或“follow the spec process”等关键词，或者想要为功能做结构化规划时触发。

say.text: 我们用spec-driven流程来规划这个功能

say.note: Claude会启动需求分析子代理。

say.text: 审批通过，进入设计阶段

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an orchestrator, never writes documents or code. It launches sub-agents for requirements, design, tasks, etc., and requires your approval at each gate before proceeding.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "use spec-driven" or "follow the spec process", or when you want structured feature planning.

say_en.text: Let's use the spec-driven workflow for this feature.
say_en.note: Claude will start the full spec-driven process.
Claude will launch the requirements sub-agent.
Claude will proceed to the next phase (design).
